            function AddFloatListener(isFloat, elementId) {

                        var headerTop = 78;
                        var elemTop = $(elementId).parent().offset().top;
                        if ($(window).scrollTop() < elemTop - headerTop) {
                            $(elementId).css('position', '');

                        }

                            var footerTop = $("footer").offset().top;

                            else {

                            }
                        }
                    }
                    window.addEventListener('scroll', floatListener);
                }

    <script>
    function navUrl(ele) {
        if ($("#" + ele).length > 0) {
            $("#" + ele).trigger('click');
        } else {
            $("[data-ref='" + ele + "']").trigger('click');
        }
    }


    var fetchHrefFromSkimLinkOrRegularTarget = function(target) {
        if ('skimlinksOriginalHref' in target)
            return target.skimlinksOriginalHref;
        else if ('href' in target)
            return target.href;

        return "";
    };

    var modifyHrefLink = function(updatedHref, target) {

        var encodedUpdatedHref = encodeURIComponent(updatedHref);
        var currentPage = encodeURIComponent(window.location);
        target.href = `https://go.skimresources.com/?id=130832X1670657&url=${encodedUpdatedHref}&sref=${currentPage}`;

    }

    var affiliateLinkChecker = function(target) {

        var pattern = /^((http(s)?):\/\/)?(([\w]+)\.)*?(ebay)\.([\w]+)(\/.*)?$/gi

        var href = fetchHrefFromSkimLinkOrRegularTarget(target);
        var isAffiliate = pattern.test(href);

        return {
            href: href,
            isAffiliateLink: isAffiliate,
        };

    };

    var linkInterception = function(target, mobile) {
        var affiliateLinkCheckerObj = affiliateLinkChecker(target);
        
        if ("isAffiliateLink" in affiliateLinkCheckerObj && "href" in affiliateLinkCheckerObj) {
            if (affiliateLinkCheckerObj.isAffiliateLink) {
                try { Page.ui.loader.loader(true); } catch (err) { }
                var completeSkimFormatUrl = target.href;
                $.ajax({
                    url: `https://snoopy.fixya.com/validate?url=${encodeURIComponent(affiliateLinkCheckerObj.href)}`,
                    type: 'GET',
                    dataType: 'json',
                    crossDomain: true,
                    success: function(data) {
                        if (data.message !== "success") {
                            modifyHrefLink("https://www.ebay.com/", target);
                            window.location.href = target.href;
                        } else {
                            window.location.href = completeSkimFormatUrl;
                        }
                        
                    },
                    error: function(_, __, err) {
                        console.log(err);
                        window.location.href = target.href;
                    }
                });
            } else {
                responsiveLinkInterception(target, mobile);
            }
        }
    };


    function responsiveLinkInterception(target, mobile) {

        var hash = target.hash;
        var href = target.href; //.toLowerCase();

        var currentLoc = $(window).scrollTop();
        //Current page remove #
        var currentUrl = location.href.split("#")[0];

        var onlyHash = target.href.replace(currentUrl, '');

        if ($(target).data("reload")) {
            window.location = currentUrl;
        }

        if ((hash === "" && target.href === location.href) ||
            (hash === "" && href === "") ||
            onlyHash === "#" ||
            onlyHash.indexOf("javascript:") > -1) {
            $('html, body').animate({ scrollTop: currentLoc });
            return;
        }


        if (hash !== "") {
            try {
                $('html, body').animate({
                        scrollTop: ($(hash).offset().top - 120)
                    },
                    800,
                    function () {
                        // Add hash to the end of url
                        window.location.hash = hash;
                    });
            } catch (err) {
            }
        } else {

            if (!matchRespLinks(href) && location.hostname === target.hostname && mobile)
                window.location = href + (target.search !== "" ? "&r=false" : "?r=false");
            else
                window.location = href;
        }

    }

    var matchRespLinks = function(text) {

        var regexResponsiveRoutes = [
            /\/(.+)\/(t|r)(\d+)-(.+)$/,
            /\/(.+)\/(p)(\d+)-(((?!\/top-10-faq).)+)$/,
            /\/(.+)\/(troubleshoot)(.)*$/,
            /\/troubleshoot\/([^/]+)\/(.)+$/,
            /\/troubleshoot((\/([^/])+))?(\/page-\d+)?$/,
            /\/(motorcycles|atvs|cars|recreational-vehicles|support)(\/[^/]+)?(\/page-\d+)?$/,
            /\/(motorcycles|atvs|cars|recreational-vehicles|support)\/([^/]+)\/((?!top-10-faq)([^/])+)((\/recent|\/popular|\/solutions|\/problems))?(.+)?(\/page-\d+)?$/,
            /\/((tags\/.+)|tags)/,
            /\/unsolved_problems\/(.+)/,
            /\/f\/(tags|landing|search|unsolved_problems)\/(.+)/,
            /\/ask\/askdetails.aspx/,
            /\/ssl\/sign(.*).aspx/,
            /\/ssl\/myprofile.aspx/,
            /\/ssl\/verifyemail.aspx/,
            /\/ssl\/changepassword.aspx/,
            /\/myhome.aspx/,
            /\/dashboard.aspx/,
            /\/search.aspx/,
            /\/signout.aspx/,
            /\/forgotpassword.aspx/,
            /\/contact/
        ];
        var result = false;
        regexResponsiveRoutes.forEach(function (regexExp) {
            if (regexExp.test(text)) {
                result = true;
                return false;
            }
        });

        return result;

    };
    </script>
